owner_approved_goal.description: JetSetCraft should also have a distinct mode with fun levels and end bosses, combining platformer, Metroidvania and roguelike play.
genre_pillars: 3D skating platformer with fun authored levels
Metroidvania world connectivity, exploration, backtracking and traversal gating
Roguelike/roguelite run variation and meaningful replay
real level-end bosses and a climactic final boss

proposed_level_modules.purpose: teach responsive skating platforming; hub with a visible future shortcut
vertical exploration plus acquiring a run-local traversal unlock
interconnected secret/backtrack routes and a true stage-ending boss
different authored seeded paths with actual movement support prerequisites
final route and multi-phase boss testing earned traversal skills

mandatory_run_features: seeded stage graph with meaningful room connections
stateful room and ability gate reachability
authored platforming, checkpoints, secrets and backtracking
run-scoped traversal unlocks and separate persistent progression
genuine stage end boss and multi-phase final boss
server-owned completion, failure, awards and replay
safe return and cleanup with no world/inventory/provider damage
original assets and rights-cleared event-only audio
